note: Sightline checks against data/landmarks.json. Observers stand on the ground at a player's eye height (1.62) unless a set says otherwise; hub sets are repeated from a 10-block rooftop (eye 12); summits and rims are targets at ground level. Hub observers are the largest flat site in each hub region (tools/find_sites.py, 4 degrees, below y190), not towns: no town has been placed. A target written @landmark* is the landmark's whole extent: its outline every 64 blocks plus its 40 highest points, visible if any one of them is. Named anchors test a single point; a flat-topped summit's centre is hidden by its own rim from below, so anchor results for clipped summits understate visibility.
